# Source: original fixture

Authored for the trustabl test corpus. Synthetic files for MCP-218, MCP-221, MCP-222, MCP-223,
RAW-003, CSDK-209 and CSKILL-094: a Python MCP server with a tool that puts a table name into a
PRAGMA statement, a tool that returns a credential-named environment value and a tool that writes
a password parameter to a mem0 client; a TypeScript MCP tool that returns `process.env` token text;
a Python module in which a chat-completion result reaches `subprocess.run` and a parameter reaches
`ClaudeAgentOptions(resume=...)`; a skill whose script prints a module-level credential value; test-path
files (not judged); and a `safe/` folder with the same shapes written with a table allowlist, a bound value, a
set-or-missing answer, a masked slice, a key-file path, an operation allowlist and a parsed UUID.
No external code. Public-domain.
